transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our standard prepayment review, I need to gather information from each of you before I make the binding treasury decision on the proposed $8,000,000 voluntary loan prepayment this quarter. We have $18,000,000 in unrestricted cash, a $10,000,000 term loan at 7.2%, and a $5,000,000 interest-rate swap paired with it. Lender relations, treasury forecasting, and tax accounting — please share anything that could affect this transaction. I need to understand all implications before I release the payment and hedge instructions.
